description: Validate an IBAN, a payment card number (Luhn), a Norwegian organisation number (orgnr), a Norwegian bank account number (kontonummer) or a phone number, with the checksum and the normalized form where the type has them. Nothing is stored or looked up. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.

value.description: The value to check. Spaces and dashes are allowed.

name: validate_value
title: Validate a number or code
